scorecard_protocol.extra_rule: Below the attachment8 reference threshold, assume intensity grade zero in both modalities. At or above threshold, no 1-6 point grade can be inferred from a threshold alone.
scorecard_protocol.parent_rule: Diagnostic only: separately ranked panel marginals are not raw-card intensities; do not clip children to parent and silently change the scoring definition.
scorecard_protocol.scope: Explicit task2 experimental grade candidate; existing scorecard mapping and acetaldehyde proxy assumptions retained. Not the official default.

task2_protocol.selection: Per target, minimum pooled inner-validation absolute grade error; ties use the candidate order. Every inner fit constructs grades and imputes/scales features using its own training subset only.
task2_protocol.prediction: Fit six binary events grade > k per target; project each six-probability vector to nonincreasing values by least-squares isotonic regression; recover seven grade probabilities and use their conditional median.
task2_protocol.evaluation: One historical outer three-fold partition; all 50 labelled targets reported, primary comparison is 45 aroma/flavour targets. Report both individual fixed candidates and the inner-selected workflow. Do not select a winner from outer scores.
task2_protocol.candidate_qualification: Inner-selected workflow must improve primary45 MAE with positive lower endpoint of the paired fixed-OOF 95% bootstrap improvement interval, and must not worsen either grade-0 or grade-6 MAE or exact recall. This is exploratory qualification, not automatic promotion.
task2_protocol.promotion: Keep current official outputs/default model. A candidate may be explicitly loaded; formal promotion requires the later authorized task5 repeated validation and task4 downstream checks.
task2_protocol.scope: Task2 only. Two ordinal settings frozen before running; no post-result grid expansion. Labels are relative ranks, not original absolute intensity. No two unlabelled acetaldehyde proxies in accuracy denominators.
